nodes.label: Advisor Workflow
nodes.rationale: Requires a read-only advisor before implementation for high-risk or ambiguous changes so the main agent can evaluate a recommendation before modifying the project.

nodes.label: GAI Go Agent Runtime
nodes.rationale: GAI provides composable, provider-neutral typed APIs while preserving provider-native capabilities where supported.

nodes.label: Workflow.RunEvents
nodes.rationale: Preferred when event order matters because it forwards one causally ordered event stream.

nodes.label: Tool Execution Loop
nodes.rationale: The loop sends tool definitions to the model, executes requested calls, appends results to the conversation, and continues until a normal response or iteration limit.

nodes.label: Retry Policy
nodes.rationale: Retries are opt-in; an explicit policy controls transient-failure, rate-limit, and timeout retry behavior.

nodes.label: Workflow Middleware
nodes.rationale: Middleware is post-processing rather than a supervisor or handoff runtime; tool authorization belongs at the tool-execution boundary.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry Observability
nodes.rationale: GAI records safe metadata by default and only exports sensitive model and tool content when an application deliberately enables capture.
